notable_candidates.summary: CXMT announced mass production of its fifth-generation DRAM platform and two 24Gb LPDDR5X products. Nanya Technology has direct LPDDR5/5X product-category overlap, so this is tracked as medium-severity competitive-supply pressure without assuming customer loss, ASP decline or margin impact.

notes: Deduplicated against discovery state through 2026-09-19T21:01:23+08:00 and repository searches for CXMT/長鑫; no prior discovery event ID or canonical Reuters URL match was found.
Reuters was cross-checked against reporting from the World Manufacturing Convention announcement and Nanya Technology's own product catalogue for product-category overlap.
CXMT's stated +50% figure is gross dies per wafer versus its prior platform on an 8Gb baseline; it is not treated as tested-good yield, shipment growth, market share or price change.
Other reviewed items did not clear the material-new-and-identifiable-Taiwan-ticker threshold in this window; no speculative ticker mapping was written.

No historical backfill, official numeric-series modification, normalized-fundamental modification, catalyst-probability modification or Fair Value modification was performed. Fair Value V2.1 remains the sole valuation baseline.
